---
title: "Schema Table"
knitr:
  opts_chunk:
    collapse: true
    comment: "#>"
    echo: false
---

One row per table. Search matches table metadata, globs **and** raw/tidy column
names (e.g. try `sample_id`). Expand a row to see its glob and columns, with one
column per schema version (`●` = column present in that version).

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false

use("nemo", "nemo_schema_reactable")
```

```{r}
#| label: reactable

nemo_schema_reactable("tool1", pkg = "nemo")
```
